axis_type: Chronological dated UTC, not folded time-of-day
count_limit: Visible distinct markers, not a proven count of underlying reports; coincident observations may overlap, and no raw table or thinning policy is stated.

readout_tolerances.meaning: Graphical readout allowance, not experimental measurement uncertainty or statistical confidence. SNR annotations are integers; calibrated center estimates corroborate labels but do not establish the normalization baseline.

extraction_method: Color masks blue:B>150,R<100,G<120; red:R>150,G<120,B<120. Inside plot, erode3x3 to suppress thin connecting lines, count4-neighbor components of at least5 eroded pixels and use mean center. Inspect labels and full image visually. Linear least-squares axes fit to printed tick grid, independent of archive values.
independence: All44 marker centers and31/13 counts were computed before the parent supplied archive counts/ranges. UTC conversion and artifact writing occurred afterwards using only source pixel centers and fixed source tick grid, without archive adjustment.
normalization_source_statement: Article says SNR was adjusted additively for transmitted-power differentials. KP4MD5W(37dBm); WB6RQN2or5W(33-37dBm). No explicit common reference power or per-point normalization values are provided.
gate_caveat: Absence of a stated global Target-Active Gate does not prove no unstated selection was used. It prevents attributing the software gate to the author.
continuity_caveat: Straight lines connect observed markers across long gaps; they are not extra receptions or evidence of continuous coverage.
